basic_details.job_title: HPU Recruitment 2026 - Walkin for Guest Faculty Posts
basic_details.short_information: Himachal Pradesh University (HPU) has released the official Guest Faculty Notification 2026 at https://hpuniv.ac.in/. A total of 8 vacancies have been announced under the HPU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026. Candidates possessing the qualifications prescribed under the UGC Regulations as adopted by Himachal Pradesh University are eligible to attend the walk-in interview on 11 August 2026. The official notification PDF and walk-in interview details are available below.

content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the HPU Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download HPU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: HPU Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 8 vacancies are available – 1 for Library & Information Science, 1 for Computer Science, 1 for English, 1 for Commerce, 2 for Sociology, 1 for Social Work, and 1 for Archaeology and Ancient History.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HPU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Guest Faculty posts at HPU?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies for the Guest Faculty positions announced by Himachal Pradesh University through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this HPU recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 1500/- per lecture, with a maximum limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria are as per UGC Regulations adopted by Himachal Pradesh University from time to time.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to be held on 11 August 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Verification followed by a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted at Himachal Pradesh University, Shimla. Specific details will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age limit specified for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit for these positions.
